ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent DevOps assistant that monitors, detects, and automatically remediates cloud misconfigurations and IAM over-permissions in real time.
ideas.title: Agentic Compliance Guard for Cloud Infrastructure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Cloud Computing, DevOps & Developer Tools domain directly with hard engineering (multi-agent orchestration), avoiding simple wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A digital forensics platform that records immutable logs of evidence acquisition and processing using cryptographic hashing for cyber crime investigations.
ideas.title: SecureChain Forensic: Digital Evidence Chain of Custody
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted specifically at the Cyber Security & Digital Forensics domain, which traditionally attracts fewer teams, making category placement highly achievable.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline that ingests industrial supply chain procurement data to forecast carbon footprint spikes and suggest offset strategies using calibrated probabilistic models.
ideas.title: CarbonLedger AI: Scope 3 Emission Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous data science patterns from winning predictive analytics projects to stand out in the Sustainability & Climate Technology domain.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform for specialized medical clinics that evaluates patient symptom profiles, automates intake vetting, and builds verified trust metrics for healthcare providers.
ideas.title: MedTrust AI: Patient Acquisition & Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Healthcare & MedTech domain by building a specialized, workflow-specific agent rather than a generic medical chatbot.

ideas.pitch: An AML risk detection and investigation platform that combines transaction graph intelligence and explainable machine learning to flag complex financial money laundering networks.
ideas.title: GraphAML: Graph-Powered FinTech Fraud Ring Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates proven architecture from previous 1st place financial AI wins by emphasizing graph analytics and explainability for judges.
